name: How long does it take to repair water damage from a window leak?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair water damage from a window leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for repairing water damage depends on the severity and scope of the issue. Simple leak repairs, like recaulking, might take a few hours. However, if there's extensive water damage involving drying out affected materials, mold remediation, and replacing drywall or flooring, the process could span several days to a week or more. A professional assessment will provide a more precise timeline after evaluating the full extent of the damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time depends on leak severity; simple fixes take hours, while extensive water damage and remediation can take days to over a week. A professional assessment gives a precise timeline.
